def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and i > 0)
    n = min(sep, h - sep - 1)
    top = grid[:n]
    bottom = grid[sep + 1:sep + 1 + n]

    # The uniform separator indicates the two panels; their shared background
    # is the most frequent value, while the other values become highlighted.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in top + bottom for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[9 if top[r][c] != bg or bottom[r][c] != bg else 3
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
               if len(set(row)) == 1 and i > 0 and h - i - 1 == i)
    top = grid[:sep]
    bottom = grid[sep + 1:]

    # The panels share their background color; all other colors are objects.
    common = set(v for row in top for v in row) & set(v for row in bottom for v in row)
    bg = next((v for v in common if sum(x == v for row in top + bottom for x in row)
               == max(sum(x == u for row in top + bottom for x in row) for u in common)), None)
    if bg is None:
        bg = 1
    return [[9 if top[r][c] != bg or bottom[r][c] != bg else 3
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(sep)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    n = min(sep, h - sep - 1)
    top = grid[:n]
    bottom = grid[sep + 1:sep + 1 + n]

    # The shared panel background is the color occurring in both halves
    # that is not the separator color.
    top_colors = {v for row in top for v in row}
    bottom_colors = {v for row in bottom for v in row}
    shared = top_colors & bottom_colors
    shared.discard(grid[sep][0])
    bg = next(iter(shared), 1)

    return [[9 if top[r][c] != bg or bottom[r][c] != bg else 3
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]
